questions: fixtures/questions_public_pilot.jsonl (frozen 20-question pilot; execute one per invocation/session)
runtime: Python 3.12.14 standard library; no third-party dependencies
retrieval: filesystem list/read plus deterministic lexical scan at call time; scan is P1R control, not Luna

telemetry.wrapper_calls: measured; one successful search operation per question
telemetry.wrapper_latency_ms: measured in each wrapper event; this is tool duration, not full agent session wall time

limitations: P1R was not separately run; these are native Luna answer sessions using the filesystem wrapper
Native tool schema cannot strictly restrict capabilities; prompts required wrapper-only access and observed wrapper calls are audited
Per-session end-to-end wall time and native token/tool counters were not exported
question_order: fixtures/questions_public_pilot.jsonl line order; one agent session active at a time
